relations.rationale: The choir gathering for rehearsal sets up the context where the conductor would ask everyone to begin warmups.
The arrangement of chairs is unrelated to Yara's promise about sheet music copies.
Zeno arriving first supports the idea that he waited alone and hummed warmups while waiting for others.
Zeno arriving first is consistent with and supports Yara later greeting him upon her arrival.
Zeno arriving first is unrelated to whether the conductor later asked everyone to settle down for warmups.
Zeno humming while waiting for others is consistent with and supports Milo arriving shortly after as one of those others.
Zeno humming quietly has no bearing on the smell of the sheet music stack.
Zeno humming while waiting doesn't relate to how long ago he joined the choir.
Hugo being treasurer has no bearing on the smell of the sheet music.
Hugo being treasurer is unrelated to where he stands in rehearsal as a bass.
Hugo's role as treasurer doesn't inherently relate to him helping stack chairs after rehearsal.
Hugo being treasurer is unrelated to Kai's offer to lock up the hall.
Milo arriving shortly after supports the detail that he was carrying sheet music upon arrival.
Milo's arrival time is unrelated to whether he's in the same class as Zeno.
Milo carrying the sheet music stack supports the detail that the stack smelled like a copier, since he's the one bringing it in fresh.
Milo carrying sheet music is unrelated to Yara's arrival time.
Milo already carrying sheet music supports the plausibility of Yara promising extra copies, as it establishes sheet music as a relevant item, but the two are otherwise weakly connected.
The smell of the sheet music is unrelated to Kai's height compared to Hugo.
The freshly copied smell of the sheet music is unrelated to Yara's promise to bring extra copies.
Yara walking in a few minutes later supports the detail that she then greeted Zeno and found a seat.
